query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM "audit_events"
          WHERE tenant_id = $1
            AND ($2::text IS NULL OR action = $2)
            AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR actor_id = $3)
            AND ($4::text IS NULL OR outcome = $4)
            AND ($5::timestamptz IS NULL OR created_at >= $5)
            AND ($6::timestamptz IS NULL OR created_at <= $6)
